title: SFDR reforms approved by EU co-legislators
lede: Ambitious fossil fuel safeguards and PAI disclosures for ESG basics category fail to pass final hurdle.

title: Burnham hails UK-EU reset on food, carbon markets and youth mobility, after Brexit ‘decade of drift’
lede: There was plenty of warmth on display at an EU-UK summit in Brussels on Friday. The agreements on carbon emissions, food and youth mobility could form the foundation for a decade of closer EU-UK integration.
